evals.name: explicit-beads-activates-tracking
evals.prompt: Use Beads to track this Product Design redesign as an epic with dependencies and acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: Route to product-design:project-status and activate Beads tracking within the requested scope without asking whether tracking is wanted.

evals.name: planning-vocabulary-offers-before-activation
evals.prompt: Plan this involved Product Design rollout with an epic, phase gates, acceptance criteria, dependencies, owners, evidence, ready and blocked states, and a next task.
evals.expected_output: Offer product-design:project-status, ask for confirmation before creating or updating Beads, and continue the Product Design workflow while confirmation is pending.

evals.name: existing-beads-may-activate
evals.prompt: This involved multi-phase Product Design project already has a .beads directory. Continue the work and keep its status current.
evals.expected_output: Route to product-design:project-status and use the existing Beads project when it matches the work; do not initialize another tracker.

evals.name: simple-one-shot-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: Make this button label clearer and tell me when it is ready.
evals.expected_output: Handle the simple one-shot request without mentioning project-status, Beads, an epic, or tracking.

evals.name: ordinary-phases-do-not-trigger
evals.prompt: First review this single card, then suggest one revised version.
evals.expected_output: Follow the small two-step request without offering or activating project tracking.
